issues: Missing exception handling in data loading function, which could lead to crashes if the file path is incorrect.
No check for empty dataset after loading, which may cause further processing to fail.
In the remove_outliers function, the outlier removal strategy is hardcoded for 'Income'. This may not be suitable for other features.
Standardize_data function is present but does not actually perform any operations.
Potential risk of data leakage in the preprocess function if the train-test split is done after encoding.
Feature selection is set to select 'all' features which may lead to high dimensionality issues.
suggestions: Implement exception handling for file operations.
Add checks to ensure the dataset is not empty after loading.
Allow parameterization of the outlier removal function to handle different features.
Implement actual operations in standardize_data if needed.
Ensure train-test split occurs before encoding to prevent data leakage.
Use a more refined method to select a reasonable number of features in feature selection.
